scene: The dial flashes departures across the city, opening three waiting departure gates.
picture: Flat side view along an open-air transit concourse. On the far left, a round white cloud cable pod hangs open from a cable. Left of centre, the woman in red bomber jacket and roller skates faces the view. In the centre, a solar-sail junk floats moored. Far right, a sleek maglev dragon train idles.
shown: a spherical white cloud cable pod floating open on the far left
a wooden solar-sail junk moored at the central sky dock
a serpentine maglev dragon train waiting with open doors far right
